messages:
maria: heads up - our async python SDK isn't picking up the custom CA chain in our Dedicated VPC setup. sync client works. anyone familiar with the async codepath?

emily: can you paste the error + how you're running the client?

maria: error is `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: unable to get local issuer certificate`. I'm setting SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE in the container.

emily: https://github.com/…/sdk has both sync and async constructors. IIRC the sync client passes ca_bundle->requests verify but async uses a baked ssl.SSLContext created by us (certifi only).

maria: minimal repro:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
c = AsyncClient(api_key="x", base_url="https://redwood.private.internal")
await c.generate("hello")
```
no way to pass a ca_bundle param currently.

kevin: that's a bug. We exposed ca_bundle on sync only. Quick plan: add `ca_bundle: Optional[Union[str, Path]]` to AsyncClient, forward to httpx via `verify=ca_bundle` or build SSLContext that loads the file. Also update typing so mypy doesn't barf.

maria: note: even if we add param, env var fallback is important. many customers rely on SSL_CERT_FILE on infra. Async constructor should prefer explicit ca_bundle, then env, then certifi.

emily: behavior change proposal: do not retry on SSLCertVerificationError. Our retry middleware currently retries on transport errors which makes the client spam logs and masks actual cert problems. Suggest `retry_on_ssl=false` default.

kevin: agreed. will implement: (1) AsyncClient(ca_bundle: Optional[str]=None) (2) if ca_bundle is provided use httpx verify path, else check os.environ["SSL_CERT_FILE"] and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE. (3) update retry middleware to treat SSLError/SSLCertVerificationError as non-retriable by default. (4) add typed stubs to accept ca_bundle and `**kwargs: Any` for forward-compat.

maria: can you also add a quick troubleshooting note in docs/dedicated.md showing how to run a quick local test with httpx to verify CA chain before we cut a patch? e.g. `python -c "import httpx; httpx.get('https://redwood.private.internal', verify='/etc/pki/ca.pem')"`

ci-bot: opened issue #4933: "py-sdk async: expose ca_bundle, honor SSL_CERT_FILE env, disable ssl retries by default" and linked this thread.

kevin: i'll take it. planning to add unit tests: (a) AsyncClient honors explicit ca_bundle over certifi, (b) env var path is respected, (c) SSLCertVerificationError is not retried. Will ping for review.

emily: thanks! small ask - include an example snippet in the SDK README for Dedicated customers showing how to set REDWOOD_API_BASE_URL + SSL_CERT_FILE in a systemd unit or k8s secret. most confusion stems from missing that example.

maria: appreciated. that'll unblock our deploy. :rocket:
